leo (sales): CedarBank POC: customers report sporadic slow first-byte during interactive demos. TTFT spikes to ~1s on short replies. Can we triage before their 16:00 call?
anya (eng-runtime): Which model/pool and region? Any sample traces?
leo (sales): redwood-chat-small on hosted-us-east, pool cedar-demo-2. They pasted a trace showing batch_wait_ms ~120 and several kv_misses.
omar (eng-sre): Metrics show short but frequent autoscaler churn + a KV shard rebalance around 15:10 -> cold-kv on some pods. Also queue size briefly hit throttle thresholds -> some 429s.
sophie (solutions): If prompts share a lot of prefix, KV prefetch will help. Recommend prefill_tokens:1 for immediate improvement.
anya (eng-runtime): Quick config to try: set batch_window_ms=6 (was 50), max_batch_size=10, enable kv_prefetch for top prefixes. That will lower TTFT but slightly reduce peak throughput. Want me to roll?
leo (sales): Roll it. Also Cedar asked about Dedicated benefits and pricing.
kevin (acct exec): Dedicated reduces noisy-neighbor-induced rebalances. We can offer a 6-month reserved at 15% off + 5k demo credits. I'll DM detailed numbers.
finance-bot: applied 5000 demo credits to cedarbank@example.com @ 1789998901
anya (eng-runtime): Tell Cedar to run this trace command and paste the JSON so we can map request->pod:
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-chat-small\",\"input\":\"<sample>\",\"trace\":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer | jq .trace
```
omar (eng-sre): I'll pin min_replicas=2 for their pool during the demo window to avoid churn. Also adding a pod warmup job to prepopulate KV for top 30 prefixes.
sophie (solutions): I'll send their security retention/KMS summary and a short runbook explaining the changes to suggest for production.
leo (sales): Cedar pasted one sample trace: {"req":"r-99a","batch_wait_ms":118,"kv_hits":1,"kv_misses":4,"model_ms":34} 
anya (eng-runtime): That's consistent. After the rollout expect batch_wait_ms <20ms. If still high, fallback option: pin to quantized variant with lower memory working set.
kevin (acct exec): If they convert to Dedicated we can include a warmup-run as part of onboarding to avoid cold-shard misses (small one-time fee).
leo (sales): Great. I'm updating Cedar before the 16:00 call with the config changes, trace command, and pricing note. Thanks team :thumbsup:
